scientific_integrity: Analytical proof and reproducible exact-rational tests. Classical Bernoulli entropy theorem is credited, not claimed new. Literature coverage subject to explicitly reported specialist risk. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed unweighted stars with k>=2 leaves; iid uniform one-edge sampling, pure neighborhood coupling, homogeneous strict positive epsilon, 0<rho<=1/2; occupation-law and parity statements need rho=1/2. Not a general consensus or topology theorem.
title: Sharp frozen-leaf threshold and parity-dependent opinion laws on stars
